moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio grid-wave, written here): 3×3 tiles (36 px, 8 px gap): y +18 → 0 px, scale 0.78 → 1, opacity in over the first 55 % — each 680 ms power2.out, starting (row + col) × 55 ms (900 ms in all). A faint shadow bar under each tile fades in with it; the sweeping guide line is not ported. Params: y (18 px) · scale đầu (0.78) · step: trễ mỗi bậc chéo (55 ms) · each (0.68 s).
